attempts.summary: Configured a persistent ufw host firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) that permits SSH (22/tcp) and 8080/tcp while denying all other unrelated inbound traffic (default deny incoming, default allow outgoing). Verified the ruleset survives a full node reboot: ufw remains enabled/active, the INPUT chain policy stays DROP, and only 22/tcp and 8080/tcp are explicitly ACCEPTed, with loopback and ESTABLISHED/RELATED traffic allowed as usual. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-reboot boot_id, triggered a native `sudo reboot`, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a changed boot_id and boot time, and re-verified firewall/service health post-restart.
